stem: Which argument would a Federalist make to support ratification of the Constitution?

options.label: F
options.text: The Constitution will enable states to nullify laws that are harmful to citizens.

options.label: G
options.text: A strong federal government will be more stable than a loose confederation of states.

options.label: H
options.text: The Constitution will allow states to establish banks to stabilize the national economy.

options.label: J
options.text: A republican system of government will better represent large states.
